# A restart used to cost everyone their in-flight work: running stages were
# cancelled on the way down, because the goroutine waiting on each runner died with
# the process image and its result became uncollectable. Three real stages died to
# one restart the day this changed.
#
# Now a restart leaves them running. The re-exec keeps the process (and so its
# children), the output goes to files rather than pipes, and the new image adopts
# them and collects the real result.
env BREEZE_DIR=$WORK/state

exec breeze register identity ci
cp stdout ci.token
exec breeze apply -f pipeline.hcl --as ci --token-file ci.token

# Start a run that will still be going when the daemon is replaced.
exec sh -c 'breeze start stage svc long abc123 --as ci --token-file ci.token >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 2'
exec breeze status stage svc long abc123
stdout 'long: running'

# A restart is REFUSED while that run is in flight, naming it — adoption would carry
# it, so the guard is about not interrupting whoever is watching, not about safety.
! exec breeze restart daemon
stderr 'refusing to restart'
stderr 'svc/long'
stderr 'actor=ci'

# Forcing is the deliberate version, and it is what this test is actually about.
exec breeze restart daemon --force
stdout 'restarted in place'

# Still running — not cancelled, not orphaned.
exec breeze status stage svc long abc123
stdout 'long: running'

# It finishes on its own and the NEW daemon records the real result, including the
# output written after the restart.
exec breeze wait stage svc long abc123 --timeout 60s
stdout 'long: succeeded'
exec breeze status stage svc long abc123 --json
stdout 'phase-1'
stdout 'phase-2-after-restart'

# A plain stop still cancels: nothing is coming back to adopt them, so leaving the
# work running under a record that says running would strand it.
exec sh -c 'breeze start stage svc long def456 --as ci --token-file ci.token >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 2'
exec breeze stop
exec breeze ping
! exec breeze status stage svc long def456
stdout 'failed \(cancelled\)'

-- pipeline.hcl --
pipeline "svc" {
  stage "long" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "2m"
    command = ["/bin/sh", "-c", "echo phase-1; sleep 12; echo phase-2-after-restart"]
  }
}
